errors.text_span: В нея са включени общо 9 сектора.
errors.evidence: The description states there are 9 sectors in the pie chart, but there are only 8 slices shown in the chart and 8 categories listed in the legend.
The category 'Касетки' (Crates), which has a horizontal line pattern, corresponds to the slice with the value 8.22%, not 17.51%.
The category 'Продукти в търговска опаковка' (Products in commercial packaging), which has a cross-hatch pattern, corresponds to the slice with the value 17.51%, not 6.63%.
The category 'Единични продукти без опаковка' (Single products without packaging), which has a vertical line pattern, corresponds to the slice with the value 6.63%, not 6.37%.
The category 'Насипи продукти' (Bulk products), which has a black and white checkerboard pattern, corresponds to the slice with the value 6.37%, not 8.22%.

The description fails to describe the specific pattern for each individual sector, which is the key visual identifier used in the chart and its legend. It only makes a general statement that the legend lists categories with their corresponding patterns.

errors.text_span: Някой от секторите са визуално подредени по размер
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that some of the sectors are visually ordered by size. The values of the slices, when read in order around the circle, do not follow a descending or ascending pattern (e.g., 23.61, 24.67, 8.22, 17.51, etc.).
There is a grammatical error in Bulgarian. 'Някой' is the masculine singular form for 'some', while the correct form to agree with the plural noun 'секторите' (the sectors) is 'Някои'.
